title: resolve_insight_candidate answer
description: The memory tool resolve_insight_candidate's answer (SB-P5-05, migration 064): one insight candidate used (action use: an insight was written from the pair) or rejected (action reject: the pair says nothing worth saying). Either way it leaves list_insight_candidates and the nightly pass never offers the pair again; the decision is the candidate's, so neither memory changes (no revision, version or history row of a memory), and who decided, when and through which channel and client is kept with the candidate. unchanged true: it was so decided already, and nothing was written; decided_at is when it was. Anyone who reads the pair's scope may decide it. Listed and answered only with memory.tools on (contracts/README.md 2.1). The JSON in its text content, and on success the same as its structured content; a refusal is isError true with the refusal body (unknown: no listed candidate the caller reads by that id, also one whose memories since left its scope, were held, marked wrong, ended or trashed; invalid: the other decision on a decided candidate). Since SB-P5-06 (migration 066) it takes note and insight_id, and answers both, with a notice that the note is stored data; a repeat answers what it was first told, insight_id only when the caller reads that insight's scope (null otherwise).

note.description: Why it was declined or used, in the deciding client's words: stored data.

insight_id.description: The insight written from the pair: one the caller read when it was named, citing both memories and no wider than the pair. On a repeat the one kept, when the caller reads that insight's scope; else null.
